Black—Victini and Reshiram| java=None| enva=N/A| }} (Japanese: '''タツキ''' ''Tatsuki'') is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and a minor character who appeared in [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']]. ==In the movies== He battled [[Iris's Emolga]] in a tournament in [[Eindoak Harvest Festival]] battle competition with his {{p|Emboar}}. Due to Emolga using {{m|Volt Switch}} to replace herself with [[Iris's Excadrill]], Iris was disqualified from the tournament and Tatsuki was allowed to continue battling. Next, he went to battle {{Ash}} where he faced his {{AP|Oshawott}}, and his Emboar was defeated by a powerful {{m|Aqua Jet}}. ===Pokémon=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Tatsuki |width=72 |pkmn=Emboar |type1=Fire |type2=Fighting |img=Tatsuki Emboar.png |epnum=M14 |epname=White—Victini and Zekrom
Black—Victini and Reshiram |desc=Tatsuki's only known Pokémon is an {{p|Emboar}} which he used to battle in the Eindoak Town tournament. At first, it went up against [[Iris's Emolga]] and found itself unable to keep up with the small Pokémon. However, Emolga's disobedience ended up winning the match for Tatsuki when she used {{m|Volt Switch}} to call out {{TP|Iris|Excadrill}}, causing Iris to be instantly disqualified. Next, Emboar was sent up against [[Ash's Oshawott]]. However, once again Emboar's poor speed was an issue and it was knocked out thanks to Oshawott's recently-mastered {{m|Aqua Jet}}, eliminating Tatsuki from the tournament. Emboar's known moves are {{m|Flamethrower}} and {{m|Flare Blitz}}.}} ===Pokémon competitions=== Tatsuki has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Eindoak Harvest Festival|Eindoak Harvest Festival Battle Competition]] - {{tt|Unknown|Won 1 amulet}} (''[[M14|Pokémon the Movie: White—Victini and Zekrom, Black—Victini and Reshiram]]'') ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size: 80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{fire color dark}}; background: #{{fire color}};" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{fire color dark}}; background: #{{fire color light}}; width:140px; height:140px"| [[File:Sugimori Mako Tatsuki Leeku anime.png|250px]] |- | [[Ken Sugimori]]'s design of {{mov|Mako|3=14}}, Tatsuki, and [[Leeku]] |} ==In the manga== Tatsuki appears in the {{ma|White—Victini and Zekrom|manga adaptation}} of the fourteenth movie. He is only seen battling {{Ash}}. Tatsuki sends out Emboar against [[Ash's Oshawott]] and was knocked out by an {{m|Aqua Jet}}. ===Pokémon=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Tatsuki |pkmn=Emboar |type1=Fire |type2=Fighting |img=Tatsuki Emboar M14 manga.png |epnum=White—Victini and Zekrom (manga) |epname=White—Victini and Zekrom |desc={{p|Emboar}} is Tatsuki's only known Pokémon. He sent it out against {{AP|Oshawott}} when he was in a tournament held in Eindoak Town. Due to Emboar having problems with its speed, it was taken out by Oshawott's {{m|Aqua Jet}}. None of Emboar's moves are known.}} ==Trivia== * Tatsuki is the only Trainer with a fully evolved Unova [[first partner Pokémon]] in [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']] to have battled another Trainer other than Ash. ** He is also the only Trainer with a fully evolved Unova first partner Pokémon in [[M14]] to win at least one battle in the tournament onscreen. *** However, he only won when {{TP|Iris|Emolga}} caused {{an|Iris}} to be disqualified due to {{m|Volt Switch}}'s effect of switching out. ==Related articles== {{M14 navbox}}[[Category:Animation characters]][[Category:Movie characters]] {{Project Anime notice|mov}} [[de:Tatsuki]] [[es:Tatsuki]] [[fr:Tatsuki]] [[it:Tatsuki]]
